visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands carefully places a whole green pumpkin into a black Toshiba steam oven. The lighting is bright and industrial, highlighting the oven's reflective glass surface and digital display. (2) The hands, now wearing a dark protective cloth, pull out the steaming tray. Visible vapor and steam rise from the hot pumpkin as it is moved onto a yellow cutting board. (3) A sharp chef's knife is used to cut the softened pumpkin into halves and then into thick wedges. A silver spoon is used to remove the inner seeds and fibers efficiently. (4) A middle-aged woman with dark hair, dressed in a light blue denim shirt and a bright pink apron, stands in a modern kitchen. She holds a white storage container, preparing the pumpkin pieces for the next stage. (5) Various vegetables including orange carrots, white onions, and red tomatoes are sliced into uniform pieces on the yellow board. The camera uses top-down and close-up angles to show the precision of the cuts. (6) In a bright red Le Creuset pot on an induction cooktop, garlic slices and onions are sautéed in oil until translucent. The kitchen environment is clean and well-organized. (7) Hot water and a soup base packet are added to the pot with the vegetables. The mixture begins to simmer, showing bubbles and light steam on the water surface. (8) Sliced chicken breast is seasoned with salt and wine before being added to the simmering vegetable broth. The woman uses a pink spatula to stir the ingredients. (9) The previously steamed pumpkin wedges and fresh cabbage are added to the pot. The soup turns a rich orange-red color as it cooks under a closed lid. (10) A small ceramic bowl is filled with fresh green onions, diced onions, and garlic. The boiling hot soup is poured over these fresh aromatics to release their scent. (11) The woman holds a red bowl and uses chopsticks to taste a piece of chicken and a spoonful of broth. Her facial expression is one of delight and satisfaction as she eats.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 南瓜太硬可以先放蒸烤爐裡. (2) [Subtitle]: 100度 蒸12~15分鐘 (也可以用電鍋蒸...). (3) [Subtitle]: 蒸完取出來放涼... (4) [Subtitle]: 蒸過的南瓜，會很好切. (5) [Subtitle]: 去籽後，分切成等分. (6) [Subtitle]: 切成大塊... (7) [Subtitle]: 取用需要的份量... (8) [Subtitle]: 剩下的放到保鮮盒保存. (9) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔切成滾刀塊. (10) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥剖半，切成大塊狀. (11) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍裂開來.. (12) [Subtitle]: 黑柿蕃茄、牛番茄各一顆. (13) [Subtitle]: 分切成等分... (14) [Subtitle]: 高麗菜洗乾淨，切成大塊狀. (15) [Subtitle]: 青蔥切成蔥花... (16) [Variety]: 開始煮囉!! [Emoji]: ❤️. (17) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡放入油... (18) [Subtitle]: 把蒜頭放入鍋裡煸香... (19) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥、紅蘿蔔放入鍋裡. (20) [Subtitle]: 把洋蔥炒出香味... (21) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、胡椒調味... (22) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥炒到半透明狀... (23) [Subtitle]: 番茄放進來... (24) [Subtitle]: 把番茄稍微攪拌炒一下... (25) [Subtitle]: 均勻裹上油脂即可. (26) [Subtitle]: 加入1500ml左右熱水. (27) [Subtitle]: 加入秘密武器 [Emoji]: ✅❤️. [Subtitle]: 無調味昆布柴魚高湯. (28) [Subtitle]: 沒有高湯，用熱水煮也是可以 就是味道會單調一點. (29) [Subtitle]: 煮滾後，轉小火. (30) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋，小火燉煮15分鐘. (31) [Subtitle]: 將雞胸肉洗乾淨 逆紋切成厚片... (32) [Subtitle]: 逆紋切，可以讓口感比較嫩 [Emoji]: ❤️. (33) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、清酒. (34) [Subtitle]: 抓醃一下... (35) [Subtitle]: 好囉，湯底煮好了！ [Emoji]: ❤️. (36) [Subtitle]: 把高湯包拿出來 擠壓出湯汁.. (37) [Subtitle]: 把南瓜塊，放進來. (38) [Subtitle]: 轉小火，南瓜塊大約煮10分鐘. (39) [Subtitle]: 煮到筷子可以輕易戳下去. (40) [Subtitle]: 試喝一下，一點鹽、胡椒調整鹹味. (41) [Subtitle]: 好喝的哈佛湯底就完成啦～ [Emoji]: ❤️. (42) [Subtitle]: 依照喜好再放入高麗菜. (43) [Subtitle]: 火轉到最小，把雞胸肉用泡熟的方式... (44) [Subtitle]: 慢慢泡熟的方式，雞胸肉才會爛喔！ [Emoji]: ❤️❤️. (45) [Subtitle]: 大概雞肉轉白，就差不多可以關火了. (46) [Subtitle]: 嫩嫩的～ [Emoji]: ❤️. (47) [Subtitle]: 爆汗湯的吃法： [Subtitle]: 蔥花、洋蔥末、蒜末. (48) [Subtitle]: 依照喜好放入碗底... (49) [Subtitle]: 將熱熱的湯沖到碗裡... (50) [Subtitle]: 激發香辛料的香味！ (51) [Subtitle]: 放入南瓜塊等... (52) [Subtitle]: 超好吃、超爆汗的『哈佛蔬菜湯』新吃法！ [Emoji]: ❤️❤️. (53) [Subtitle]: 哇！湯頭充滿蒜香～ 洋蔥脆脆的口感. (54) [Subtitle]: 南瓜超鬆軟～ [Emoji]: ❤️❤️. (55) [Subtitle]: 喝了這個湯 整個疲勞都消除子！ [Emoji]: ❤️❤️.
